_about: Reusable assets every Fan Economy reel can draw on. Every asset carries provenance (who made it, what right we have to use it). The renderer refuses an asset with no provenance, and the per-video assets.json a project writes copies this record beside every use, so any frame can be traced to its source. Paths are WSL paths; a missing file is reported by `reel assets`, never silently skipped.

sheets._about: The script's own printed sheets, generated by generate-fan-economy-images.mjs from the script's NANO BANANA PRO PROMPT blocks. Their role comes from POSITION FROM THE END, the same rule FE-SKILL-008 enforces: the last sheet is the CTA, the one before it is the reveal (and may letter the withheld figure), the first is the hook. So the reveal sheet is gated to the reveal exactly like a reveal graphic.

drop._about: Sourced B-roll (artist footage, interviews, headlines, posts) goes in <project>/broll/ as the media file plus a same-named .json sidecar: {"source":"...","url":"...","rights":"fair use: 3s commentary excerpt","shows":"what it proves","reveals":[] }. No sidecar, no use. Never download commercial music or full clips for this.

_crop: crop is a fraction box {x,y,w,h} of the source frame applied before anything else, for footage where the thing that matters (a phone screen) is a small part of the frame. startAt is where in the recording the useful part begins.
